name: io.github.wenboteng/sepa-validator
title: SepaCheck Validator
description: Validate SEPA pain.001 and camt.053/054 files with the free checksepa.com API.

tools.name: validate_sepa
tools.description: Validate one SEPA XML document (pain.001.001.03 or pain.001.001.09) against the XML Schema plus SEPA checks (IBAN, BIC, amounts, control sum, dates). Free: 30 per IP per hour and 200 per UTC day without a key, or 500 a month with a free API key. Limit 10 MB. The file is not stored. Returns valid, format, version, errors, and warnings. Each finding has code, message, path, and line.

tools.name: camt_validate
tools.description: Validate one ISO 20022 bank statement (camt.053.001.02, camt.053.001.08, camt.054.001.02, or camt.054.001.08) against the official XML Schema. Shares the free limit with validate_sepa and camt_convert. Limit 10 MB. The file is not stored. Returns valid, format, version, errors, and warnings.

tools.name: camt_convert
tools.description: Convert one camt.053 or camt.054 statement (.02 or .08) to normalized JSON or CSV. JSON statements include account IBAN, balances, and entries with amount, currency, creditDebit, bookingDate, valueDate, counterpartyName, counterpartyIban, remittanceInfo, and endToEndId. A credit uses the debtor as the counterparty. A debit uses the creditor. Shares the free limit. Limit 10 MB. The file is not stored. format is json (default) or csv.
